lines.text: Hi guys! Welcome back to day sixteen of thirty one days of Halloween!
She says that like it's a gift. It is a hostage situation.
Day nine, she posted me sneezing into the cauldron.
And it did numbers!
Excuse me. Some of us were in the background of that sneeze.
Guys, this is Hubert. He's been in every video since day one.
Against my will. I came from a farm. I had prospects.
He had a vine. Now he has a windowsill.
And that's Peanut. Peanut doesn't usually talk.
Peanut talks in October. Peanut has range.
Okay! Today's idea. Spooky snack!
No. I have eaten every spooky snack.
Mummy hot dogs. Eyeball grapes. Graveyard brownies with real dirt.
There was a worm in mine.
Leave Gary out of this.
Who is Gary?
Gary was the worm. He was a good worm.
Fine. Idea two. Live pumpkin carving!
I beg your pardon.
Hubert, you're the only pumpkin I have.
I've watched you film one dance thirty eight times. I know every step. I don't have legs.
Honestly? The pumpkin has a point.
Also, I've gone a little soft on the bottom.
How soft?
If you lift me, part of me stays on the windowsill.
That's why the room smells like a candle that gave up.
That's the pumpkin spice plug in!
There is no plug in, Nadia. I am the plug in.
Idea three. The classic. Jump scare my little brother.
You're saying that out loud. In front of me.
Just look at your phone.
I'm always looking at my phone. That's not acting.
Peanut, you're on lights.
I'm a hamster. But okay.
Three, two, one, go!
Lights are off.
Boo!
Hi, Nadia.
I screamed. Did anyone else scream?
Why aren't you scared? I wore the mask!
That mask lives on the fridge. I say good morning to it.
We all do. His name is Frank.
Day sixteen has nothing. Let me check the comments.
Wait. Why does every comment say, where is the hamster?
Thirty one days of hamster is my favorite show? Thirty one days of hamster?
That's me. I post at night. From your phone. You charge it next to my box.
How many followers do you have?
Two million. And a guy in Ohio who mails me sunflower seeds.
Nadia has nine hundred, and that counts Grandma twice.
Also, I finished all thirty one days. I'm on Thanksgiving now.
You finished Halloween by the sixteenth?
Kid. You plan October in July.
Peanut, please. What do I post today?
Easy. Look at the fridge.
Why is Frank looking at me?
Say good morning, Nadia.
Okay, that counts! Day sixteen is done!
Wonderful. Fifteen more days. Somebody please just make me a pie.
